# Reminder lists (1.13): iOS makes a list with MKCALENDAR and the
# component set VTODO (name, color, order), renames it and changes its
# color with PROPPATCH, deletes it with DELETE. The first own list makes
# the virtual "Erinnerungen" real as well (as "privat" with the first
# calendar), so a device that saw it keeps it.
> MKCALENDAR /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <B:mkcalendar xmlns:B="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav">
>   <A:set xmlns:A="DAV:">
>     <A:prop>
>       <A:displayname>Einkauf</A:displayname>
>       <D:calendar-color xmlns:D="http://apple.com/ns/ical/" symbolic-color="green">#34C759FF</D:calendar-color>
>       <D:calendar-order xmlns:D="http://apple.com/ns/ical/">2</D:calendar-order>
>       <B:supported-calendar-component-set><B:comp name="VTODO"/></B:supported-calendar-component-set>
>       <B:calendar-timezone>BEGIN:VCALENDAR
> BEGIN:VTIMEZONE
> TZID:Europe/Berlin
> END:VTIMEZONE
> END:VCALENDAR</B:calendar-timezone>
>     </A:prop>
>   </A:set>
> </B:mkcalendar>
< status 201

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:B="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/" xmlns:D="http://apple.com/ns/ical/"><A:prop><C:getctag/><A:displayname/><D:calendar-color/><D:calendar-order/><B:supported-calendar-component-set/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< responses 4
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ cs:getctag 0-0
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/ d:displayname Einkauf
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/ ical:calendar-color #34C759FF
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/ ical:calendar-order 2
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/ cal:supported-calendar-component-set <cal:comp name="VTODO"/>
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/ d:displayname Erinnerungen
< value-lacks /caldav/alex/calendars/erinnerungen--titanos/ cs:getctag 0-0

# Renamed and recolored on the iPhone.
> PROPPATCH /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propertyupdate xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:D="http://apple.com/ns/ical/"><A:set><A:prop><A:displayname>Wocheneinkauf</A:displayname><D:calendar-color>#FF9500FF</D:calendar-color></A:prop></A:set></A:propertyupdate>
< status 207
< prop /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/ 200 d:displayname ical:calendar-color

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 0
< status 207
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/ d:displayname Wocheneinkauf
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/ ical:calendar-color #FF9500FF
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/ d:resourcetype <d:collection/><cal:calendar/>
< body-has -1</cs:getctag>

> MKCALENDAR /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/
> Auth: alex
< status 405

# An entry in it, then the list goes with DELETE (with its reminders).
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/4E2A9C11-7B3D-4F60-A1E2-3C4D5E6F7081.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-None-Match: *
> Body: todo.ics
< status 201

> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/
> Auth: alex
< status 204

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 0
< status 404

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/5A7C9E1B-3D5F-4A2C-8E4B-6D8F0A2C4E6A/4E2A9C11-7B3D-4F60-A1E2-3C4D5E6F7081.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 404

# The last list stays (as the last calendar), and deleting a list never
# touches the calendars.

> Auth: alex
< status 403
